limitations: A fresh Generate is not executable: it stops at the bootstrap boundary until CONTROL.BOOTSTRAP.1 adds CONTROL creation for a fresh task, which also needs request text a Generate request does not carry today.

A run whose recorded context is not a CONTROL object still cannot be continued; retrieve text, empty full or deep contexts and a harness-blocked {} answer invalid_control_json (for {} the entry answer was the harness's source_missing; neither calls a model).
A run whose recorded context is exactly the text null would be read as the fresh form; no producer records it.
